items.text: Manafinder's eight patch has been released! (v1.08)

It's a minor patch that includes a couple of bugfixes and other changes. There is no new content in this patch. Once again, thank you for playing Manafinder! And apologies to those who encountered any of these issues. Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
On other news... The console port is coming along, making steady progress. The port is being handled by Ratalaika Games.
And Manafinder II is in development. I'm hoping to make a formal announcement sometime early 2026!
Patch Notes 1.08
Fixed several spelling and grammar mistakes.
Bugfix: The Anniversary Gallery notification will only be shown once at the Emerald Peak.
Bugfix: The Magi Scythe in a boss fight in the third chapter has been patched to be immune to many status ailments such as blind. Why would a scythe go blind? :)
Bugfix: Fixed a bug where Frederick's message window would appear transparent when speaking with him outside the Tuonela.
Bugfix: Fixed a bug where under some conditions the komaleaf healing bonus acquired by doing Sohralia's questline would result in 0.
Bugfix: Nature's Harmony magic now works as expected.
You will now start New Game+ and New Game++ with 50 additional Blessing Points that you gain at the start of Chapter V.

releases.displayName: Steam Cloud is now enabled + Mac version has been updated!

items.text: Steam Cloud is now supported! All of your saves will be backed onto Steam Cloud the next time you launch your game.
Saves are not cross-compatible between Mac OS and Windows, instead, they are backed separately.
Additionally, the Mac version has been updated with a bugfix. In some Mac environments, the game would crash when entering Illia's Cauldron. This issue has now been corrected.
Thank you for playing Manafinder! It's been a wonderful year, and I'm incredibly grateful for all of your support!
Manafinder's (first) anniversary is actually next week, but the weeklong celebrations have already started!

Secondly, Manafinder has been updated with an in-game "Anniversary Gallery" where you can browse concept art as well as special art, including the beautiful anniversary art made by Angel Cervantes. The "Anniversary Gallery" can also be viewed from the official website with some extra liner notes.
Stay tuned on our social media for other very special announcements in the following days! :)

You may access the "Anniversary Gallery" in the Northern Lake overlook located in the northwest corner of The Settlement. The gallery is unlocked after having climbed the steps right after camping in the Emerald Peak.
Fixed an issue where pressing F12 key would open the Developer Console.
Manafinder's sixth patch has been released! (v1.06)

It's a minor patch that includes three minor bugfixes. Once again, thank you for playing Manafinder! And apologies to those who encountered any of these issues. Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
Fixed a bug where Sohralia would reward you with a 0HP Komaleaf healing enhancement.
Fixed a bug where sometimes the bartending graphics would not be removed properly after concluding the bartending minigame.
Fixed a translation bug where the trash can text in the bartending minigame would not be translated into Spanish.

releases.displayName: Silent Blessing trial bugfix has been released!

items.text: Manafinder's fifth patch has been released! (v1.05) This is a pretty minor patch, but it addresses a pretty elusive bug that prevented players from advancing through Leaves' Rest in Chapter III when they disabled the Command Remember option.
Once again, thank you for playing Manafinder! And apologies about this issue to those who encountered it. Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
Fixed an issue where players were unable to finish the Leaves' Rest trial to obtain the Silent Blessing if they disabled de option Command Remember in the Options -> General section.

releases.displayName: Manafinder's third patch has been released ft. QoL updates!

items.text: Hello everyone! Thank you all so much for playing Manafinder! I've released a third patch that addresses a few issues plus adds a QoL update to help you track Heavenstones.
Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
Added Batho's assistant (located in Batho's tent) who will tell you which areas you've found Heavenstones at.
Added "Red Berries" item in the lake viewpoint.
Increased the price of status enhancing items.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to walk out of bounds in Aevi's Edge.
Fixed an issue where the Autosave will be soft-locked during Batho's conversations.
Fixed an issue where Einar would still be in Illia's Cauldron camp even after clearing Chapter 2.
Fixed an issue where some items could K.O. you outside of combat.
Batho's Assistant will help you locate the Heavenstones! She will mention more areas as you progress through the game! :)
I hope you keep enjoying Manafinder!

releases.displayName: Manafinder's second patch has been released!

items.text: Once again, thank you all so much for playing Manafinder! And thanks again for reporting issues! I've released the second patch that addresses both bugs that have been reported so far plus one that I've observed.
And remember... Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
Fixed an issue where the Drown spell would do damage twice per cast.
Fixed an issue where the Item Possession count window would not close after purchasing an item in both Joachim's and Priscila's shops.
Multiple spelling corrections. (Spanish)
I hope you keep enjoying Manafinder!

releases.displayName: Manafinder's first patch has been released!

items.text: Thank you all so much for playing Manafinder! And thanks for reporting bugs! I've released the first patch that addresses most of the reported bugs so far.
Please keep reporting any issues on this thread!
Fixed an issue where under certain conditions you may be able to spend a Blessing Point on an already acquired blessing, thus wasting your BP.
Fixed an issue where additional Blessings under Allaror's TP Category would not be unlocked.
Fixed an issue where saying "No" to Dama the first time would disable battle commands.
Fixed an issue where using attacks that target multiple enemies against the Shrubs and Shrubhogs made the fight endless.
Fixed an issue where resting the second time at Illia's Cauldron won't allow you to go to sleep.
Fixed an issue where saving your game was accidentally disabled near the Point of No Return.
Fixed an issue where Octavius would cast Sharpen on Hexa instead of himself.
Fixed an issue where the "Taunt" ability by the Woodbois may freeze the game.
Fixed an issue where the text indicating the Sanctuary's basement ladder is locked would not be translated when switching languages. (Spanish)
Multiple spelling corrections. (English)
Multiple spelling corrections. (Spanish)
Credits have been updated.
I hope you keep enjoying Manafinder!

Manafinder will be released this October 5 2022, which also means that the time has finally come to delist the demo from Steam. Said deactivation will happen this week on 09/28. I've prepared an FAQ to answer any potential questions and concerns you may have about this. Also, feel free to drop a comment below so I can answer any additional question you may have!

notes.title: Why now, so near the release date?

items.text: I've been meaning to deactivate it earlier, however the demo was a great way to showcase the game on a couple of events, such as the Seattle Indies Expo 2022 which just happened on 09/24: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/six2022
That unfortunately left a very small window between said events and actual release.

notes.title: Why not leave the demo up?

items.text: The demo and final build have diverged significantly since January/February 2022. While at a first glance they make look very similar, "behind the scenes" there have been some changes. But most importantly, see the question below about the save file.

notes.title: Can I transfer my save file to the full release?

items.text: Short answer: No, at least I don't recommend it for two reasons:
1. You will miss some Steam achievements activation.
2. Save file may cause some bugs further down the line, specially if your save file is from the earlier releases (2021) of the demo.

I understand this is not ideal, and I apologize for this in advance. I'm happy to hear your comments here, and if this is a very contentious point I will definitely try to the best of my abilities to provide alternatives such as perhaps providing a save file that leaves you near the end of the demo.

notes.title: But I want to try out Manafinder before buying it!

items.text: If you really really insist on still trying the demo even after reading the warnings above, then know that I will leave the demo up on other non-storefront websites, such as rpgmaker.net
Alternatively, the demo was picked up by a couple of gamers that posted their playthroughs on YouTube! Example:
Thank you all for understanding and supporting Manafinder. I really hope that you enjoy the final release! And remember, I am happy to hear you out below in case you have any concerns!
